title: The Goose That Laid the Golden Eggs
author: Aesop · V. S. Vernon Jones 英译
difficultyNote: 情节简短清楚；保留 1912 年英译的个别旧词与句式。
background: 每天得到一枚金蛋的人，想要一次拥有更多。这则完整寓言讨论贪心与耐心。 英文采用 V. S. Vernon Jones 1912 年译本。
backgroundEn: A couple receive a golden egg each day. This complete fable asks what happens when steady good fortune is not enough.

paragraphs.en: A Man and his Wife had the good fortune to possess a Goose which laid a Golden Egg every day. Lucky though they were, they soon began to think they were not getting rich fast enough, and, imagining the bird must be made of gold inside, they decided to kill it in order to secure the whole store of precious metal at once. But when they cut it open they found it was just like any other goose. Thus, they neither got rich all at once, as they had hoped, nor enjoyed any longer the daily addition to their wealth.
Much wants more and loses all.
